description: Structured lookup of Supreme Court of the Slovak Republic decisions by their extremes, without the text (replaces the legacy query_judikatura). Filters, all optional and combined with AND: cislo (case number prefix, for example 8Cdo/21/2014 written with its slash), ecli (exact), court (NSSR or NSSSR), kolegium (1 civil, 2 commercial, 3 administrative, 4 criminal), senat, datum_from and datum_to (decision date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). sort (datum_desc default, datum_asc, cislo); a missing date is always last. limit (1..50, default 20) and offset page the result; every row carries total, the size of the filtered set. Rows: id, court, cislo, senat, ecli, datum_rozhodnutia, kolegium, kolegium_nazov, merito, sudca, source_url, text_source, total. A call without any parameter lists the newest decisions. Read a decision with sk-judikatura_rozhodnutie. Example: {"court": "NSSR", "kolegium": 3, "sort": "datum_desc", "limit": 10}.
